task.title: Define Pantheon tool permission model for upstream OpenClaw integration
acceptance: [CODEX NOTE] any tool that calls LEAN directly must be restricted to paper/backtest context only in the permission model — live execution must always flow through REG → SIG → L, never through a direct O → L tool call
task.next: OC-001 APPROVED for v1 lock. Review written at services/control-plane/permissions/review_oc001_claude.md. Key: deny-first model + 6 mandatory deny rules + approval hooks all aligned with router v1. Two minor open items (allow_with_approval not in schema effect enum; promotion-state not checked at router layer) documented but do not block v1.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：deny-first 模型、強制 deny 規則與 approval hook 都已和 Router v1 對齊。
後續只需追蹤兩個 minor open items：policy schema 是否要直接表達 allow_with_approval，以及 promotion-state 是否要在 router 層做二次確認。
task.summary_zh: 定義 Pantheon 的工具權限模型，並把 upstream OpenClaw 的工具能力映射到 deny-first allowlist/denylist 規則。
